  'input_text.ev_site_anemonevej_price_source',
  'input_text.ev_site_ia_moellersvej_price_source',
  'input_number.ev_charge_long_trip_safety_margin_minutes',

  'input_number.blue_flux_optimizer_battery_capacity_kwh',
  'input_number.blue_flux_optimizer_max_ac_kw',
  'input_text.blue_flux_charge_rule_anchor_value',
  'input_datetime.blue_flux_charge_rule_deadline_value',
  'input_boolean.blue_flux_optimizer_long_trip_active',
  'sensor.blue_flux_broker_battery_level',
  'sensor.blue_flux_broker_charge_limit_actual',
  'sensor.blue_flux_broker_location',
  'binary_sensor.blue_flux_broker_charge_cable_connected',
  'sensor.blue_flux_broker_charger_state',
  'sensor.blue_flux_battery_level',
  'number.blue_flux_charge_limit',
  'device_tracker.blue_flux_location',
  'binary_sensor.blue_flux_charge_cable',
  'sensor.blue_flux_charging',

  'input_number.ellingo_optimizer_battery_capacity_kwh',
  'input_number.ellingo_optimizer_max_ac_kw',
  'input_text.ellingo_charge_rule_anchor_value',
  'input_datetime.ellingo_charge_rule_deadline_value',
  'input_boolean.ellingo_optimizer_long_trip_active',
  'sensor.ellingo_broker_battery_level',
  'sensor.ellingo_broker_charge_limit_actual',
  'sensor.ellingo_broker_location',
  'binary_sensor.ellingo_broker_charge_cable_connected',
  'sensor.ellingo_broker_charger_state',
  'sensor.ellingo_battery_level',
  'number.ellingo_charge_limit_2',
  'device_tracker.ellingo_location',
  'binary_sensor.ellingo_charge_cable',
  'sensor.ellingo_charging'
];

const cycle = `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;
flow.set(`evopt_cycle_${cycle}`, { expected: entities.length, received: 0, states: {}, started: Date.now() });

const requests = entities.map(entity_id => ({
  _evopt_cycle: cycle,
  _evopt_entity: entity_id,
  entity_id
}));

const timeout = { _evopt_cycle: cycle, _evopt_timeout: true, payload: Date.now() };
return [requests, timeout];

name: ≤ 0.5 øre/kWh difference = same price → earliest wins
info:
Configure with input_number.ev_charge_price_equal_tolerance_ore_per_kwh.
Example: 0.4054 vs 0.4044 DKK/kWh differs by 0.001 DKK = 0.1 øre/kWh.
With 0.5 øre tolerance, the earlier/current slot is selected.

name: CHEAP BOOST: <0.50 DKK/kWh → temporary target 80%
info:
Rules:
1) Only valid charging site + cable + Production.
2) Normal charge limit must be below boost target.
3) If current SoC already reached normal limit: boost immediately and charge continuously while price is below threshold.
4) If current SoC is below normal limit: only boost if current contiguous cheap window is long enough to reach boost target.
5) If denied for insufficient window, suppress boost until price rises above threshold; do not reconsider mid-window.
6) At end of cheap window / boost target / leave site / disable: restore saved original limit.
7) External/manual charge-limit change during boost cancels boost WITHOUT restoring old value.
8) Long trip >=85% is untouched because Cheap Boost only activates when current limit < boost target.

name: PRICE ORDER: cheapest group → earliest time
info:
Example with tolerance 0.5 øre/kWh:
11:45 = 1.1684 DKK/kWh
10:15 = 1.1734 DKK/kWh

Difference = 0.0050 DKK = 0.5 øre, so both belong to the same effective price group.
10:15 is selected first because it occurs earlier.

This grouping is deterministic and avoids comparator instability.

name: Accumulate driven km v1.2
v1.2: planned slots + daily/weekly/monthly/yearly km
info:
Planned slot strings are published to HA per car.
Distance tracking uses odometer deltas and persistent cumulative counters. First read is baseline only. HA utility_meter derives day/week/month/year per car and combined.
Blue Flux known source: sensor.blue_flux_odometer. ElLingo is auto-discovered; manual override is available via input_text.ellingo_odometer_entity.
